### Linkpad v1.5.2 (Build 15)
- Fixed quick access notification visibility with dedicated channel and full RemoteViews styling
- Added categorized submenus per remote type (Touchpad & Media, PC Power Controls, Roku TV Remote)
- Added full Roku TV action support (TV Power, D-Pad, Volume, Home, Back, HDMI 1)
- Direct local Wi-Fi Roku ECP execution with server fallback
- Immediate notification permission prompts and Android Settings guidance
